answers.core: It's a core modification to GDScript and it seems quite bizarre to me that this _isn't_ allowed. I can't see a single benefit to having RefCounted's exist and also not be maually free-able.
answers.workaround: _Kind of?_ I'm going to try restructuring my infrastructure around returning WeakRefs where possible (or just use Objects). In either case, this sort of defeats the purpose of a RefCounted object - which exists for convenience.

title: Allow manually freeing instances of RefCounted
